TEST AND FIX THE SHOWCASE CIRCUIT VISUAL SCENE AS A COHERENT RACE VENUE. The user has driven the current implementation and reports that things are all over the place. Treat this as a scene-layout QA/fix pass, not a compile audit.

Focus on src/graphics/tracks/showcaseCircuit.ts visual placement and trackside dressing. Do not alter BMW M5 vehicle physics equations/tuning/validation code. Preserve the original plane mode exactly.

Inspect every permanent scene element relative to the route: barriers, kerbs, runoff, pit lane, pit wall, paddock, grandstands, gantries, braking boards, landmark tower, tunnel beams/posts, canyon rocks, bridge supports, trees, and mountains. Identify anything that intersects the asphalt/runoff, floats, sinks, blocks sightlines, spans the wrong local axis, is placed using hard-coded world coordinates that do not match the actual track, appears inside another structure, or creates obvious random clutter.

Hard acceptance criteria:
- Keep a clear racing corridor: asphalt plus at least ~3 m beyond track edge should never be occupied by scenery/barrier geometry except intentional kerbs and correctly aligned guardrails.
- Barriers must follow the route and remain outside usable runoff; their height/orientation should be believable.
- Kerbs should align to the actual local tangent/bank and not alternate chaotically across the road.
- Pit lane/paddock/grandstand must be anchored to a known start-straight sample and oriented from the local tangent/lateral basis, not arbitrary world axes.
- Gantries/tunnel structures must span perpendicular to the driving direction and provide comfortable vehicle clearance.
- Bridge supports must never intrude on either deck's racing corridor or underpass clearance.
- Rocks/trees must use exclusion distance from track/runoff, and the canyon should read as deliberate rather than noise.
- Reduce or remove decorative elements if placement cannot be made robust. Coherence beats object count.
- Preserve strong spectacle with fewer, better landmarks.
- Prefer route-relative placement helpers so future control-point changes do not scatter objects.

Produce a concrete patch that makes the scene clean, legible, and consistent. Include any deterministic geometry/exclusion checks you can reasonably add within allowed source files. Required gates remain npm run test:conventions, npm run test:m5-validation:strict, npm run build.
